The main goal of the project is to catalog and audit various kinds of software and firmware images for these systems.

homepageintro:
What is Hasheous?

Hasheous is a free service that matches MD5 or SHA1 hashes of ROMs and digital games with metadata providers for those games.

How does it work?

When adding a ROM to a supported ROM manager;

  • the hash of the ROM is sent to Hasheous
  • Hasheous looks in its internal database to see if there is an existing match - if so, it returns the links to the stored metadata to the calling client
  • if there is no match, Hasheous will attempt to search the supported metadata providers and return its findings to the calling client, and stores the metadata match to the database for any further lookups

If a match is incorrect, or missing, then the user of the ROM manager manually corrects the data in their local ROM manager, then the fix will be sent to Hasheous as a 'vote'. Once a match has enough votes, the value of the match will change to match the community consensus.

termsofservicetext:
Hasheous is a free service, run for the community, with the goal of being useful and fair to everyone who uses it.

Keeping the service running

Because Hasheous is free to use, we rely on rate limits and caching to keep hosting costs manageable and the service fast for everyone. Please don't try to bypass these limits.

When we may suspend or block access

We reserve the right to suspend or block access for anyone who:
  • Exceeds or circumvents rate limits in a way that places undue strain on the service, or
  • Engages in offensive, abusive, or otherwise harmful behavior while using the service

No warranty

Hasheous is provided free of charge, on an as-is basis. The Hasheous team is not responsible for any data loss, downtime, or other issues that may result from using the service.

No copyrighted material

Hasheous does not, and will not, provide binaries or links to copyrighted material.

Third-party metadata attribution

If you access third-party metadata (e.g. IGDB, ScreenScraper) through the Hasheous proxy, you agree to attribute that content to its original source in your application, including a link back to the source content, as required by those providers.

Third-party data sources

Hasheous acts as a proxy to third-party metadata providers and is not responsible for the accuracy, availability, or licensing terms of the data they supply. Your use of any third-party metadata is also subject to that provider's own terms of service.

Agreement

By using Hasheous, you agree to these terms.
privacypolicytext:
Hasheous is built to respect your privacy. We only collect what we need to run the service, we only keep it as long as we need it for that purpose, and we will never use your data for advertising or sell it to third parties.

What data does Hasheous collect?

  • Email address - used for authentication and account-related notifications
  • Password - stored securely (see "How we protect your data" below)
  • Language preference - used to display the Hasheous UI in your preferred language
  • Game Match Submissions - the metadata matches you submit
  • API usage data (if you use the metadata proxy) - see below

API usage data

If you generate an API key to access the Hasheous metadata proxy, we log basic usage data to understand how the service is being used and to plan capacity. Specifically:

  • Your IP address is anonymised using a one-way, deterministic method before storage - we don't retain your raw IP address.
  • We do not store the content of your requests (query strings or request bodies).
  • We do not store your API key itself.
  • Each log entry is tagged with your internal account ID, solely so usage can be grouped per user - this is not used to inspect what you searched for or retrieved.
  • Usage data is kept for 30 days, and is progressively aggregated (hourly → daily → weekly → monthly) so that detail is reduced over time.

How does Hasheous use your data?

  • For authentication (email and password)
  • For sending you service-related notifications
  • For displaying the Hasheous UI in your chosen language
  • For storing your Game Match Submissions, linked to an internal user identifier to prevent duplicate submissions
  • For understanding API usage and planning service capacity (see above)

We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or any purpose unrelated to running Hasheous.

How does Hasheous share your data?

Hasheous does not share your data with any third party, except where legally required to do so (for example, in response to a valid legal request from a court or law enforcement agency).

If you choose to link an OpenCollective account to support Hasheous via donation, that linking is a separate, manual action you take - Hasheous does not receive or store any payment or donation data from OpenCollective.

How does Hasheous protect your data?

  • All connections to Hasheous require HTTPS
  • Passwords are salted and hashed before storage
  • The only cookie we use is for keeping you signed in - we don't use tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies

How long does Hasheous keep your data?

  • Account data (email, password, language) is kept for as long as your account remains active.
  • Game Match Submissions are retained even after account deletion (see below), as they contribute to the shared metadata database.
  • API usage logs are kept for 30 days, in progressively summarised form, as described above.

Inactive accounts

To avoid keeping data longer than necessary, Hasheous automatically manages accounts that have been inactive for an extended period:

  • After 18 months of inactivity, we'll email you to let you know your account is inactive and may be deleted if it remains unused.
  • After 23 months of inactivity, we'll send a final reminder.
  • After 24 months of inactivity, your account will be automatically deleted, and we'll notify you by email that this has happened.

As with manual account deletion, your Game Match Submissions are retained but anonymised - the link between the submission and your identity is permanently removed.

Your rights

You can delete your account at any time. When you do:

  • Your account and all associated identifiers are deleted immediately.
  • Your Game Match Submissions remain in the Hasheous database, but are anonymised - the link between the submission and your identity is permanently removed.
  • Your account will be removed from any Apps you may have permission over. If you are the last user with permission over an App, that App will be removed.

By submitting a Game Match, you grant Hasheous the right to retain and use that submission, even after your account is deleted, so it can continue to benefit the community.

If you have questions about your data, or want to raise a concern, please get in touch (see "Contact" below).

Contact

You can reach the Hasheous team via:

  • GitHub: https://github.com/gaseous-project/hasheous
  • Discord: https://discord.gg/Nhu7wpT3k4

Changes to this Privacy Policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. The current version will always be posted on this page.
